subject: vt-dy
title: (R)VT.DY.------POL.P.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-20, on the page where Braxton names the realness of black creativity as 'the most basic generating stimulant for American creativity because it was the only thrust projection that drew its dynamics from the composite American vibrationaltory arena.' (R)VT-DY — the reality of vibrational dynamics — is crossed with POL-P (political policies). The diagram poses: black creativity's actual vibrational dynamics are inseparable from the political-policy regime that defines its cultural reception. VT-DY branches to PART (participation) → SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) → TRS (transition), and TRS branches to RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) and to ALT-F (alternative functionalism). Besides the main line to the crossing partner POL-P, VT-DY runs to CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis), which branches to INFO-INTR (information interpretation) and to MT-INFO (multi-information) → INDIV-TP. The structural argument: the reality of vibrational dynamics — the *actual* sounding/feeling — only enters multi-information through culture affinity basis, and reaches INDIV-TP only at one further remove.
